reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes edge dislocations increase lattice friction and act as barriers; in BCC metals, screw dislocations have higher lattice friction (Peierls stress) and control strength, especially at low temperatures, making the proposed mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on comparing mechanical properties and TEM-measured dislocation character between edge-promoted and control samples.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamental misunderstanding of dislocation mobility in BCC alloys, so testing it would not advance understanding of strength-governing mechanisms in refractory HEAs.
